Perfect pizza & pasta, with great staff and love the industrial vibe!
Oct 2025 • Couples
My partner had eaten here a number of times and wanted me to try the pizza and pasta, and I was definitely not disappointed. The vibe is modern with an industrial look; concrete mixes with exposed brickwork but it feels cosy not cold. 

You wait for a table to be free downstairs at the entrance before ascending the stairs (which may be a little narrow for some). 

We were on the top floor and the place was buzzing with busy servers and happy customers. 

Our friendly waiter happily made a few recommendations but we had decided on pizza and also the crab pasta, washed down with a couple of cold in-house beers. 

From our perch we could watch our pizzas being prepared below! 

Our 1/2 & 1/2 pizza consisted of 3 cheese on one side and on the other, Burrata Parma Ham. It was wonderful, with a light and crisp base and cooked to perfection. 

The Crab tomato Cream Spaghetti was also delicious; fresh, light and already a firm favourite. 
Very much looking forward to our next visit to Saigon - and to PIZZA 4 P’S.

Don't Bother
Mar 2026 • Couples
Over the years I've eaten at 4P's multiple times in different cities and can tell you the pizza is monumentally failure compared to pizza in Europe, Canada and the US. 
Pizza is first and foremost all about the dough, the crust. You want a chard, crispy result. Although you may see some blackened bits on 4Ps pizza, the dough has a horrible white bread consistency. Like cheap doughy tasteless, characterless white bread. The toppings were decent though it’s not enough to save this sinking ship.
I fail to see what the hype is all about.

Apparently just hype, a social media snowball effect. People at my table were saying Pizza hut is so much better, which is itself substandard.
Don’t waste your time or money.
